name: WF-Payment-Reminder
description: Receives payment data via webhook. For each package with pending balance > 0, resolves guardian email and sends a payment reminder via Gmail. Includes payment URL if available. Prevents duplicate reminders per package.

input.to: {% set recipients = [] %}{% for e in step_1['emails'] %}{% set _ = recipients.push(e.guardianEmail) %}{% endfor %}{{ recipients | join(',') }}
input.subject: Payment Reminder — {{step_1['emails'][0]['studentName'] || 'Student'}}
input.body: {% if step_1['emails'][0] %}{{step_1['emails'][0]['body']}}{% else %}No pending payments to remind.{% endif %}
